title: How your client signs in to their portal

steps.caption: Clients
steps.narration: Your clients sign in to their portal without a password. Here is what they do.

steps.caption: Open a client
steps.narration: Take one client. Here, Hannah Lindqvist, in Buffalo.

steps.caption: The address you have for her
steps.narration: Signing in works with the email address you have on file for her.

steps.caption: The portal's sign-in page
steps.narration: Now her screen. This is the portal's sign-in page.

steps.caption: Email me a sign-in link
steps.narration: And chooses Email me a sign-in link.

steps.caption: Check your inbox
steps.narration: The page tells her to check her inbox. The link works for thirty minutes.

steps.caption: She opens the link
steps.narration: She opens the email, and chooses the link in it.

steps.caption: Signed in
steps.narration: She is signed in, under her own name. There is no password to remember.

steps.caption: Her documents
steps.narration: Her estimates, invoices, contracts, photos and messages are all in the menu.

steps.caption: Back to the CRM
steps.narration: Back in the CRM, there is nothing for you to set up.

steps.caption: Where to find it
steps.narration: Every client you add under Clients gets a portal.

youtube.title: How clients sign in to their portal, no password | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: Clients of a contractor using the ConstructHUB CRM sign in to their portal with a link sent to their email address. No password is needed. This walkthrough shows the sign-in from the client's side. Recorded in a demo workspace with a made-up client.
